title: OMNIEDUBENCH: A COMPREHENSIVE CHINESE BENCHMARK FOR EVALUATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN EDUCATION
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark that explicitly includes a 'cultivation dimension' for evaluating Large Language Models. This dimension contains specific subcategories and question sets dedicated to 'moral education', 'Character & Values', and 'Integrity & Honesty', which are used to assess the models' capabilities in fostering moral and value development in educational contexts.
